intro: Jamshedpur's five zones are shaped by its two rivers. Central Jamshedpur, with Sakchi and Bistupur, is the old heart of the city; the west takes in Kadma and Sonari and, across the Kharkai, Adityapur and Gamharia; the south grows out of Tatanagar Junction through Jugsalai, Parsudih and Burmamines; the east is the planned and plotted colonies of Telco Colony, Birsanagar, Baridih and Govindpur; and Mango and Dimna lie across the Subarnarekha. Most homes are houses or apartment buildings rather than large gated complexes, though Sonari and Adityapur societies keep registers. A tutor's real question here is which bridges they are willing to cross at peak hours.

Jamshedpur students follow JAC, CBSE, and CISCE's ICSE and ISC. The Jharkhand Academic Council is the state's board and holds the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations for its affiliated schools, so a JAC student needs a tutor who teaches from the prescribed textbooks and practises in the board's own format. CBSE builds its papers on NCERT and now gives many marks to applying ideas, while ICSE and ISC expect long answers over a broad syllabus. The CBSE session starts in April, and JAC and CISCE schools follow calendars announced in their own notices, so plan around each school's dates.

Home and online teaching work well together here. A request from Birsanagar is matched first with tutors in Birsanagar, then the rest of the eastern zone, then the city, then online tutors, and the family sees two or three with fees shown before a free first demo; switching later is free for them. Tutors living on the Mango side, or on the same bank of the Kharkai as the family, keep weekly lessons steadier. Online sessions help for ISC electives or senior specialist subjects when the right tutor lives across the river or in another city.

zone_notes.Central Jamshedpur: Sakchi Market and the Bistupur shopping roads crowd in the evening, so book before the market rush or park in a residential lane. Flats in Bistupur and Sakchi often keep a gate register while houses in Circuit House Area and Sidhgora are doorstep visits, and tutors living here can also reach Mango by the regular buses and autos from Sakchi. A slot before the market rush is the easiest to keep.
zone_notes.West Jamshedpur & Kharkai Side: Bridges define this zone: two cross the Kharkai from Adityapur and the Domuhani bridge links Sonari with Dobo, and bridge traffic peaks at office hours. Sonari and Adityapur societies register visitors and set parking rules, so send your vehicle number ahead, and Gamharia's plots and houses are easiest to serve from Adityapur. A tutor from the same bank, or a slot after the rush, keeps lessons regular, and Gamharia families can add online classes for senior subjects.
zone_notes.South Jamshedpur & Tatanagar: Housing here is mostly private houses and builder flats rather than large gated complexes, and tutors from Jugsalai, Parsudih, Burmamines or Telco Colony can move around without crossing a river. Jugsalai's market lanes crowd during trading hours, and train times add traffic on the Tatanagar station roads, so allow a buffer. Write Burmamines as Burma Mines as well when sharing addresses, since both spellings are in use, and look for parking just off Jugsalai's main lanes.
zone_notes.East Jamshedpur: Birsanagar is divided into twelve zones over a wide area, so always ask for the zone number and a landmark, and most homes here allow parking at the door. Factory shift traffic around Telco Colony shapes lesson times, and Govindpur is most practical for tutors from Telco Colony, Parsudih or Birsanagar. Set lesson times after factory shift traffic has cleared, and add online sessions for specialist senior subjects in Govindpur.
zone_notes.Mango & Dimna: Mango is joined to Sakchi by three bridges, and a daily crossing at busy hours is the hardest part of any schedule, so tutors living on the Mango side are the natural fit. Apartment complexes in Mango ask for a name at the gate, Dimna's houses are doorstep visits, and work on the NH 18 elevated corridor slows Dimna Chowk and Pardih. Off-peak slots and online evenings help while the corridor is built.

boards: Jamshedpur tutors teach JAC, CBSE, and ICSE and ISC students. For JAC, take the syllabus, papers and dates from the Jharkhand Academic Council's official site and work from its prescribed textbooks. CBSE sample papers and marking schemes are on the CBSE academic site, and ICSE and ISC regulations on the CISCE site. A clear answer on how the JAC, CBSE or CISCE paper for a given class is set is what a family will look for at the demo, so prepare it for every class you list.

board_cards.name: Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC)
board_cards.note: The Jharkhand Academic Council holds the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations for its affiliated schools across the state, Jamshedpur included. A JAC student needs a tutor who teaches from the prescribed textbooks and practises in the style of the council's own papers; take dates and patterns only from jac.jharkhand.gov.in.

board_cards.name: CBSE
board_cards.note: CBSE families in Jamshedpur are spread from Bistupur flats to Telco Colony houses. Prepare from NCERT and the CBSE sample papers and marking schemes, and be ready to explain at the demo how the paper for that class is set. The CBSE session starts in April, ahead of the JAC and CISCE calendars.

board_cards.name: CISCE (ICSE and ISC)
board_cards.note: CISCE conducts the ICSE after Class 10 and the ISC after Class 12. Long, organised answers, set literature and project work define both, and ISC electives may need a specialist, whom families can reach online. A Jamshedpur tutor should read the specimen papers on cisce.org before a demo.

board_cards.name: IB Diploma Programme
board_cards.note: Students on IB courses in Jamshedpur usually work with an online specialist from elsewhere in India. If you teach the Diploma, whether Maths AA or AI or a science at SL or HL, an online offer reaches them; coach the internal assessment but never write it, and keep to the ibo.org subject guide.

board_cards.name: Cambridge / Pearson Edexcel IGCSE
board_cards.note: IGCSE students in Jamshedpur, too, usually learn online. Teach command words, the Core or Extended tier, and past papers marked against the official scheme, and check whether the school follows Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel. A specialist in another city can serve them; syllabuses are on cambridgeinternational.org.

women.intro: NXTutors invites women tutors in Jamshedpur to teach at home, online or both. You fix the areas and hours: a tutor in Sakchi might stay within Central Jamshedpur and Mango, linked by regular buses and autos, while one in Telco Colony keeps to the east and teaches Sonari students online. The same ID check applies to every tutor, a parent is home for the free demo, and the safeguarding policy sets rules for tutors and parents. Treat these as the platform's controls, not assurances about anyone.
points: Pick home, online or hybrid, and change the choice whenever you need.
Your travel areas are up to you; if crossing the Subarnarekha or Kharkai bridges late does not suit you, stay on your own side.
Your listed free hours show Jamshedpur families when you can teach, so add late slots only by choice.
The free demo, where we ask a parent to be at home, is always the first meeting.
Sonari, Adityapur and Mango complexes register visitors; ask the family to give the gate your name and vehicle number ahead of the demo.
Arrange fees and timing through a parent, not in private messages with the student.
Teach young children in a shared space with an adult in the house; online, keep cameras on.
If something feels wrong, end the classes and tell NXTutors, marked Safeguarding; in an emergency, call 112 first.

story: Sign up with a one-time code on your phone or email, and list your subjects, classes and boards, JAC, CBSE or CISCE, and the Jamshedpur areas you can reach, from Bistupur to Mango.
A government photo ID is uploaded and reviewed by the team before families see you. Each ID number belongs to one tutor account; the review checks identity only, not police records.
After the review, your profile is live with the Verified badge, showing your boards, the areas you travel to, the hours you keep free and the fee you set.
A parent in Sonari or Birsanagar sends a request. NXTutors gives them two or three tutors, from the same area first, then tutors who travel there, the zone, the city and online.
The parent sees your fee before booking, and the first class is a free demo at their home with a parent there, so you can judge the student and the bridge route.
Teach at homes on your side of the river, online for students across Jharkhand and India, or both, perhaps a weekend visit with online classes on weekdays.
faqs: How will a Jamshedpur family's request reach me?

The family shares the class, board, subjects, neighbourhood with the nearest market or landmark, and the times that work. NXTutors puts forward two or three tutors, considering the same neighbourhood first, then the zone, then the rest of Jamshedpur, then online. Neighbourhoods and boards listed accurately on your profile help the match.
Can I take online students while living in Jamshedpur?

You can. Teach at home on your own bank of the river and online for students in the rest of the city or elsewhere in India. Home requests see local tutors first, but a family that asks for online tuition, for instance for an ISC elective, can be matched with you directly whatever its location.
How should I decide which Jamshedpur areas to cover?

Decide by the bridges. A tutor in Sonari can reach Kadma and Bistupur without the Kharkai crossings, one in Sakchi can reach Mango by the regular buses, and one in Birsanagar may keep to the east. List only the areas you can reach at lesson time, every week, without strain.
Is there a verification step for tutors?

Yes. Tutors who join go through an ID check: confirming a phone number or email with a one-time code, then uploading a government photo ID for the team to review before the profile goes live. Real tutors who pass carry a Verified badge. It is an identity check only; see /how-we-verify-tutors.
Where do I see what each tutor plan includes?

On /pricing, which lists the current tutor plans and their contents. Your fee per lesson is your own decision and is shown to the family before their free first demo; families can change tutor later at no charge, so it is the quality of your lessons that keeps a student with you.
Can a woman tutor in Jamshedpur avoid crossing the rivers?

Yes. You decide the areas you travel to, and home requests follow those areas, while the hours you keep free tell families when you are available, so you can teach at home on one side of the Subarnarekha and take students across it online. A parent is home for the free demo before anything regular is agreed.
Which boards do Jamshedpur families ask about?

JAC, the Jharkhand Academic Council, along with CBSE and CISCE's ICSE and ISC; IB and Cambridge IGCSE students usually work with online specialists. Families look for a clear answer on how the paper for their class is set, so list only boards and classes you know.
Can I teach one Jamshedpur family both at home and online?

Yes. Tick both modes and agree the split after the demo. Where a bridge crossing at office hours makes weekday trips unreliable, a weekend home lesson for written work, with online classes in between, keeps the weekly timetable steady for everyone.
